text:
karim: initiating staged rollout for search-core v3.0.1-hotfix. plan: 4% -> 12% over 25m. change window 00:30-02:30 UTC. targeting us-west-2 first. rollout id rl-2026-03-21-04

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-04 started: routing 4% traffic to v3.0.1-hotfix (service=search-core).

nina: running smoke + index validation. I'll watch p95/p99 and query error rate.

thomas: seeing a small but consistent uptick in 429s for one shard (us-west-2c). posting logs.

thomas: log excerpt:
```
WARN throttler: reject request id=abc123 reason=rate-limit shard=us-west-2c
METRIC queries_per_sec 1200 -> 3200 (1m)
```

karim: hold expansion at 4% while we triage. nina/thomas, can you confirm whether this is client-side backpressure or server-side rate limiting?

nina: running targeted requests now. client retries look normal; server metrics show increased queue length and search-worker CPU spikes on us-west-2c.

ops-runbook-bot: recommended actions: 1) pause rollout 2) pin affected shard to previous version v3.0.0 3) collect heap and worker queue dumps. Recommended commands below.

ops-runbook-bot: pause cmd: `deployctl rollout pause --id rl-2026-03-21-04 --reason "hold: search-worker queue/p99 CPU us-west-2c"`
ops-runbook-bot: pin cmd: `routingctl pin --service search-core --to-version v3.0.0 --shard us-west-2c`
ops-runbook-bot: rollback cmd: `deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-04 --to-version v3.0.0 --confirm`

deploy-bot: pause request received from karim. executing pause...

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-04 paused at 4% (user: karim). state=PAUSED. note=\"hold: search-worker queue/p99 CPU us-west-2c\"

thomas: capturing worker queue and heap profiles now. creating ticket INFR-2508 and assigning to infra-oncall.

qa-bot: running gold query set against us-west-2c. will post pass/fail.

nina: QA shows degraded tail latency on the shard; replays show higher fanout for a subset of ranking rules in v3.0.1-hotfix.

karim: quick consensus check: pin us-west-2c to v3.0.0 and keep rollout paused globally until INFR-2508 triage and a bench/patch? React with :thumbsup: to pin+hold, :thumbsdown: to keep investigating without pin.

thomas: :thumbsup:

nina: :thumbsup:

karim: pin approved. applying routing pin.

deploy-bot: routingctl: pin applied -> service=search-core shard=us-west-2c -> version v3.0.0. routing change id rc-10111.

deploy-bot: rollout remains PAUSED. no automatic traffic increases.

karim: updating release notes: "search-core v3.0.1-hotfix stalled: pinned us-west-2c to v3.0.0 due to elevated queue length and p99 CPU; infra ticket INFR-2508 opened."

ops-runbook-bot: rollback snippet if needed:
```
# rollback globally
deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-04 --to-version v3.0.0 --force --confirm
```

infra-oncall (bot): INFR-2508 acknowledged. initial triage indicates worker-side GC behavior under certain ranking rule combinations. ETA 40m for mitigation plan.

karim: QA and infra will coordinate on a targeted patch or tuning. owner=karim, status=PAUSED_PINNED. keep this thread as the canonical thread for updates and any resume decision.

thomas: uploading queue dump and flamegraphs to INFR-2508. will post progress here.

qa-bot: will re-run gold set after infra update and post result.

karim: thanks team. we'll reconvene here once infra confirms fix and QA is green; then we can decide resume path (retry from 4% or full rollback).
